notes.title: UPDATE: Full VR Support on Launch!
notes.notes:
After announcing the new enhanced version of Soul Axiom, we are proud to reveal that Soul Axiom Rebooted will receive full VR support on Steam for HTC Vive, Oculus Rift, Valve Index and Windows Mixed Reality on February 27th.

With over 40 beautiful yet haunting locations, VR support was one of the top requested features from our community since the birth of Soul Axiom on Steam Early Access. Now with a complete engine upgrade, we can finally offer the experience everyone has been waiting for!

HOW TO PLAY
Soul Axiom Rebooted is designed to be played with or without a VR device. Only one purchase is necessary, you will be given the option to play in VR or Non-VR when starting the game. You are free to switch between modes and carry on where you left off.
 
VR LOCOMOTION
- Teleportation (coming soon)
- Smooth Artificial Locomotion
           - Thumbstick Navigation
           - Head Tracked Navigation
           - Hand Tracked Navigation (Onward)
 
GAMEPLAY AREA
- Seated
- Standing
- Room-Scale
 
SUPPORTED CONTROLS
- Standard controller
- Oculus Touch
- Steam Index Knuckles
- Vive Controller
- Windows Mixed Reality controller
- Keyboard & mouse
 
ADDITIONAL VR FEATURES
- Smooth rotation with adjustable speeds
- Snap rotation with adjustable degrees
- Motion Tunnel Vision to limit FOV when in motion
- Adjustable UI distance
- Full game playable in VR

See the full list of new features here: https://steamcommunity.com/games/1206620/announcements/detail/1718622067703866802

Don't forget to Wishlist the game to follow the launch on February 27th

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1206620/Soul_Axiom_Rebooted/

notes.title: Soul Axiom Rebooted: the new enhanced version for Steam
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36715316/d27b7a31e6d5563c639e6ef6fccd8e7be8163d3e.gif

Wales Interactive are proud to reveal Soul Axiom Rebooted, the new enhanced version of the 2016 first-person puzzle game Soul Axiom. Coming to Steam and Nintendo Switch on 27th February 2020.

Soul Axiom was entirely rebuilt with an engine upgrade with the purpose of releasing it on Nintendo Switch for the very first time. It brought a whole bunch of additions, improvements, optimisation and fixes, so we're proud to be offering both Steam and Switch users the best version of the game! 

[previewyoutube=c4f5VtTBZIg;full][/previewyoutube]

What's new?
For a preview of what's changed, see our notes below. For an in-depth view of the changes, and to find out what happens to the original Soul Axiom game on Steam, see our follow-up post coming very soon [tip: add the game to your Wishlist or subscribe to the forum to be notified].

About the game
Soul Axiom Rebooted is a first-person story-driven adventure puzzle game, set in the beautiful, haunting cyber-world of Elysia. The original game was released on Steam, Wii U, Xbox One and PS4 and was nominated for several awards, including Best Game at BAFTA Cymru Awards, Use of Narrative at Develop Awards and Best Console/PC Hardcore at Game Connection America.

Rebooted notes
+ Localisation support
+ A new objective marker system
+ Major optimisations throughout
+ Improved checkpoint & save system
+ Reduced completion requirements
+ Enhanced dynamic lighting
+ Many QoL improvements
+ A reduced base price
+ Free artbook & soundtrack DLC (Steam)

Don't forget, the in-depth look at these changes are coming very soon! Subscribe and Wishlist on Steam to stay up to date. 

Wales Interactive

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1206620/Soul_Axiom_Rebooted/
